purpose: Canonical regional support-item supplement pending the next monolithic planner normalization.

regional_unique_drops.support_item_effect: Restores 37.5% of maximum Prayer points over 30 seconds and has a five-minute cooldown.
regional_unique_drops.planner_value: Reusable Prayer sustain for long combat or skilling sessions. The item is tradeable in the base game, but a no-trading League route depends on Kandarin access to the Lost Grove source chain.
regional_unique_drops.region_evidence: The Lost Grove sits by the Piscatoris Hunter area; the RuneScape fairy-ring directory classifies the nearby AKQ destination as Kandarin.
